description:
Start an outbound AI phone call.

        At least one of ``system_prompt``, ``llm`` or ``agent_id`` is required.
        US artificial-voice calls (47 CFR 64.1200(b)(1)) require the AI disclosure.
        Hail does not verify the lawful basis or the recipient's consent.
        ``message_type="marketing"`` also requires ``consent_source``.
        A different ``idempotency_key`` represents a new call. A 4xx response returns no key.

        Returns the call ID, status, phone numbers and ``idempotency_key``, or an error.

agent_id.description: Saved agent whose settings the call uses, from ``list_agents`` or ``create_agent``. Explicit arguments override its settings.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

ai_disclosure.description: Speak an AI notice at the start of the call. ``false`` skips it.
ai_disclosure.title: Ai Disclosure

consent_obtained_at.description: When consent was obtained, as an ISO 8601 timestamp, if known.
consent_obtained_at.title: Consent Obtained At

consent_source.description: Where or how consent was obtained, such as ``signup form``. Required when ``message_type`` is ``marketing``.
consent_source.title: Consent Source

first_message.description: Line spoken on pickup. Without it, the agent reacts to the answer or silence.
first_message.title: First Message

from_.description: Caller ID: an E.164 workspace number with voice, from ``list_numbers``. Omitted: an active workspace number, else one from the shared pool.
from_.title: From

idempotency_key.description: Retry key. The ``idempotency_key`` from an earlier response refers to that original request instead of starting a new one. Omitted: a new key is generated and returned.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

language.description: Spoken language as a supported lowercase ISO 639-1 code, such as ``es``. Omitted: English. An unsupported code returns 422.
language.title: Language

llm.description: Own model endpoint compatible with OpenAI's chat completions API: ``{base_url, api_key, model}``. Omitted: Hail's bundled model.
llm.title: Llm

message_type.description: ``informational`` for transactional or service messages, or ``marketing``.
message_type.title: Message Type

metadata.description: Free-form JSON object stored on the call record. Keys starting with ``recording_`` are reserved.
metadata.title: Metadata

recipient_consent.description: Attestation that the recipient lawfully consented to this contact. Only ``true`` is accepted.
recipient_consent.title: Recipient Consent

recording_enabled.description: Recording for this call, overriding the agent and workspace settings.
recording_enabled.title: Recording Enabled

system_prompt.description: Task instructions, added to the call agent's instructions.
system_prompt.title: System Prompt

to.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format, such as ``+14155551234``.
to.title: To

tools.description: Names of the agent tools allowed on this call. An empty list disables them. Omitted: every tool the workspace's channels support.
tools.title: Tools

name: place_call
title: Place a phone call
